clue.text: Town hall rep to ring specially

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Underworld Society sinking in obscurity

clue.text: Defeat at gala perhaps exposes weakling, largely

clue.text: For one taking time, to hurry no longer fine

clue.text: Trouble returns stopping facial hair not all that short

clue.text: Brightly coloured bag bully guards that mustn't be touched
